NetBot: Detected sustained egress throughput saturation on dedicated pools in ap-southeast-1. Auto-incident created.
Hannah Ortiz: Getting multiple customer alerts about timeouts and slow responses from Dedicated capacity in APAC. Packet drops rising on nic-agg-az2.
Devon Park: Confirmed network egress queue length high on dedicated-gw-ap-sg-*. Errors show `write timeout` from backend proxies.
Ritu Mehta: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) divert new connections to hosted fallback region (ap-northeast-1), 2) throttle background model downloads on dedicated hosts, 3) scale up egress NAT gateways if possible. Starting divert now.
Infra Oncall: Implementing diversion rule. Live command: `route set-priority --pool-dedicated-ap-sg --fallback-region=ap-northeast-1 --drain-delay=30s`
CS Ops: Notifying impacted enterprise customers and opening priority support threads. Sending advisory to APAC AE cohort.
NetBot: Diversion started on 3/4 gateways. Observed immediate reduction in new connection failures but existing sessions still experiencing packet loss until drain completes.
Devon Park: Throttled non-critical background syncs and model pulls on dedicated nodes: `sync.concurrent=2`. This should reduce bursty writes contributing to egress saturation.
Ritu Mehta: Scaling request to cloud provider for additional NAT capacity submitted. ETA unknown; pursuing transient mitigations in parallel.
Infra Oncall: Monitoring: host-level retransmits falling from 18% -> 6% after throttles and diversion. Latency for new sessions routed to hosted fallback ~+80ms but within SLO for most customers.
CS Ops: Preparing customer-facing update. Draft: "We observed degraded performance for Dedicated customers in ap-southeast-1 due to network egress saturation. Mitigations applied: failover to hosted region and throttling of background tasks. We are coordinating with the provider to restore full capacity." Approve to publish?
Hannah Ortiz: Approve but add note about targeted follow-up for accounts on dedicated SLAs.
StatusBot: Incident page created: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1801234567 (public update pending).
Devon Park: Next steps: 1) confirm cloud provider capacity increase or offer temporary burst IPs, 2) add hard caps on background syncs for Dedicated pools, 3) add alert for sustained egress queue growth >5m to detect earlier.
Ritu Mehta: Postmortem owner: Devon Park. ETA draft: 48 hours. Will include action items for routing back traffic and improving observability on dedicated egress.
Infra Oncall: Full traffic normalization observed at 12:34 UTC after diversion and throttles; provider extra capacity pending but not required for recovery.
NetBot: Alerts suppressed at 12:40 UTC; will reopen if egress queue > threshold or packet drops rise.
CS Ops: Final internal status: mitigated, most customers routed to fallback, targeted outreach in progress. Runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/dedicated-egress-saturation
StatusBot: Public message queued: "Resolved 94 Dedicated capacity in ap-southeast-1 experienced degraded performance due to network egress saturation. We applied mitigations (failover to hosted region, throttles) and service is restored for most customers. A postmortem will follow." Pending CS approval. :white_check_mark:
